rq2_per_class_table.interpretation: Hidden Fee is the clear worst performer (recall 0.056 -- essentially never correctly identified). Data Sharing is second-worst (recall 0.143). Both are the classes with the least regulatory-corpus coverage (documented separately). Safe has high recall (0.955) but very low precision (0.382) -- the classifier over-predicts Safe as a fallback, consistent with the pre-fix failure mode this session's S5 fix targeted, though the fix addressed evidence-laundering specifically, not general few-shot classification weakness on clause text alone.
